name: Ice Blocks
description: A field of ice blocks that rise and fall as waves spread out from the pointer, with drops that start ripples when it rests.

props.name: variant
props.description: A flat isometric field that fills the frame, or a field that recedes toward a horizon and fades into the background.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Edge of each cube in pixels. In perspective, the size at the near edge is about half again as large.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: How far a cube rises or sinks at the height of a wave, in pixels.

props.name: damping
props.description: How long waves last, from 0 to 1. At 0.96 a ripple crosses the field and fades in about two seconds; lower values calm the surface sooner.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for how fast the simulation runs and waves travel.

props.name: idleRipples
props.description: Let random drops start ripples when the pointer has been still for idleDelay.

props.name: idleDelay
props.description: Milliseconds without pointer movement before the drops begin.

props.name: topColor
props.description: Colour of the top faces. Defaults to snow by day and a lighter deep blue at night.

props.name: leftColor
props.description: Colour of the left faces. Defaults to a pale water shade by day and deep blue at night.

props.name: rightColor
props.description: Colour of the right faces. Defaults to a deeper water shade by day and near-background blue at night.

props.name: glow
props.description: Light the rims of cubes riding a crest. Additive at night, a fine ink line by day.

props.name: glowColor
props.description: Colour of the crest rim light.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the field. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the field. The pointer is tracked on the window, so content does not block the waves.
